Hi Alice,

Good news, you can set Ledgerly to chase for you. Here's how:

1. Go to Settings › Reminders.
2. Switch on Automatic reminders.

By default it sends one reminder 3 days before the due date, one on the due date and one 7 days after. You can change the days and the wording on the same page.

If there's a client you don't want reminders going to, open the client, choose Edit and switch off "Send automatic reminders". Other clients won't be affected.

Hope that saves you some phone calls!

If you see sign-ins, invoices or changes you do not recognise, the security team must be told at once so they can lock the account and review activity. This is always urgent.

[email-delivery] A bounced email
A bounce means the client's mail server refused the message, usually because the address is wrong or the mailbox is full. Correct the address on the client page and resend.

[team] Invite a team member
Team members are part of the Pro plan (up to 5). An owner or admin goes to Settings › Team › Invite, enters the person's email and picks a role. The invitation expires after 7 days.

[team] Roles
Owner: full access, including billing, ownership transfer and deleting the business. Admin: everything except billing and ownership. Member: can create and send invoices and manage clients. Viewer: read-only.

The owner can replace the card under Settings › Billing › Payment method. Never send card details by email or chat; Ledgerly staff will never ask for them.

[tax] Tax advice
Ledgerly calculates tax from the settings you choose but does not give tax advice. Whether you must register for VAT, and which rate applies to you, is a question for an accountant or the tax authority.
